name: OSR
description: The Whiterook rules on Tavern Moot: an AD&D-flavoured OSR system with home-brewable magic.

actions.label: Cast a spell or rune
actions.description: Cast a spell or use a fairy rune in the Magic phase. No moving this round; harmed before your side acts, it fizzles.

actions.label: Retreat from melee
actions.description: Flee or withdraw from melee. Opponents who win initiative may attack you with a bonus.

actions.label: Done moving
actions.hint: Movement is free; this ends your Movement.

fields.label: Prime Requisite XP %
fields.hint: Adjusts XP as Awarded XP is distributed to classes (B/X: -20, -10, 0, +5, +10)

fields.label: Movement
fields.hint: Base movement: feet per exploration turn, unencumbered (B/X; Dolmenwood Speed x3). Home Brew's encumbrance slows it by what is carried, and its movement rules work each scale's speed from the result
